summary: Galiano Gold Inc., a Canadian gold producer listed on the TSX and NYSE American, furnished a Form 6-K (its foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K) solely to announce the timing of its third quarter 2026 financial and operational results. Results will be released after market close on November 5, 2026, with a conference call and webcast on November 6, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. Eastern. No strategic, transactional, or capital-markets event is disclosed; no stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated, and no deal terms exist. This is a routine earnings-scheduling notice for the Asanko Gold Mine operator, carrying no risk-arb angle.
